fullDetailedEvidence.scope: Main keeps compact exact commands, output hashes, actual runtime outputs, source hashes and guard metrics; raw extended structured evidence remains in source checkpoint, raw execution file outsideGit.

ownGateObserved.criterion: Actual compiled parser -> native Bend checker steps driven by Node -> owning CheckedProgram -> native Bend JSEmit steps driven by Node -> execute returned emitted JS unchanged

ownGateObserved.datatypeHeaderCriterion: Native datatypes are headers: a forward or mutual family field, index telescope or kind resolves before its declaration, while undefined names, duplicate headers, ill-kinded fields and non-declaration bodies are still rejected by their own categories
